name: product-description
description:
Produces e-commerce product descriptions using features-benefits-proof
methodology that converts browsers into buyers. Use when the user asks to
write product descriptions, create e-commerce listing copy, write product
page text, draft product descriptions for online stores, or write copy
for product listings.
Do NOT use for landing page copy (use landing-page-copy), ad copy (use
paid-ad-copy), or full marketing campaign (use campaign-planning).
